name: lying floor row with bent knee
description: A bent-knee floor row using the elbows against the floor to lift the upper back slightly, with no external anchor needed.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent, feet flat and elbows close to your sides.
Bend your arms and press your elbows into the floor as if rowing your upper body upward.
Lift your chest and upper back a small distance while keeping your feet planted.
Pause briefly, then lower under control and repeat.
